title: TestSprite 4.0
lede: TestSprite 4.0 is a testing agent that takes plain-language goals, explores a running app, writes and runs end-to-end tests, and sorts each failure into a real bug, a test problem or an environment problem.

points: It maps the app's flows first, then runs UI and API tests in real browsers, more than 100 at once, signing itself in even with one-time codes.
Every failure comes with expected and actual behaviour plus a recording of each step.
Approved tests become a regression suite it maintains as the UI changes; what a test expects only changes with user approval.
It runs from the web app, from an open-source CLI that coding agents can drive, or on every pull request.
The team claims 94% bug-finding accuracy on its own benchmark, against 86% for Claude Code and Codex.

sections.text: Teams shipping with a coding agent and an AI reviewer where nobody actually clicks through the product before merging.
